tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The authorities provided under this subchapter terminate on December 31, 2031.

tree.heading: Termination of Corporation
tree.text: The Corporation shall terminate on the date on which the portfolio of the Corporation is liquidated.

notes.text: Amendments2025—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 119–60 substituted “December 31, 2031” for “7 years after October 5, 2018”.
